MS. RASCH: This tape was made for the Smithsonian's Oral History Project. I'm Sunna Rasch of Periwinkle Productions on the J.C. Johnson project.

The following tapes contain conversations between J.C. and me. The first interview was taken in the late Fall of 1978; J.C. had just come out of Doctors Hospital and was feeling quite fit at the time, and the tone reflects his vigor which was, unfortunately, not to last for too long.
And so the first tape begins:
